name: homie-studio
description: Make multiplayer web games, music and video in this chat, check them in real browsers, and put them online on your own Cloudflare.
long_description: Homie turns this chat into a game studio. Ask it to set up a studio and it makes one on this computer: a folder with your games, music, videos and posts, and a site with public multiplayer rooms that goes online on your own Cloudflare account (free plan, no payment method). It plans each game with you into a Game Codex, builds it, proves two browsers finish a round, and shows every step as a card in this chat: setup, build progress, the studio and the codex. No terminal and no second session. Beta: bugs and questions go to https://github.com/homie-rocks/homie/issues.

studios_folder.title: Studios folder
studios_folder.description: Where your studios live: each studio is a folder in it. Homie only reads and writes inside it.
